_comment: Copy to accounts.json (gitignored) and fill in. Use password_env to pull secrets from the environment instead of storing them here. Four strategies are implemented: smoke_atm_roundtrip (P1 smoke test), reddit_sentiment_qqq (#22), trump_whisperer_qqq (#29), and momentum_qqq; the dip/rip/cheap-ATM ones are still P3. The runner validates strategy_id at startup and refuses to start rather than crashing mid-run on an unregistered one. The split below is deliberate -- running every account on one strategy only measures variance -- and the three reddit_sentiment_qqq accounts run conservative / default / aggressive thresholds so the Automated tab's per-strategy rollup compares something real. Neither sentiment strategy needs credentials: reddit_sentiment_qqq scrapes Reddit's public new.json (with a headless-browser fallback for Reddit's JS challenge, optionally set REDDIT_USER_AGENT as a courtesy identifier); trump_whisperer_qqq (alias 'TrumpWhisperer' below) polls the public trumpstruth.org/feed RSS mirror of Trump's Truth Social posts, optionally set TRUMP_FEED_USER_AGENT the same way. Both return no_trade -- rather than crashing, or in TrumpWhisperer's case rather than closing a held position -- below min_sample_size or if ingestion fails. momentum_qqq (alias 'Newton' below) needs no credentials or external feed either -- its signal is the trailing return of the same underlying_price every other strategy already reads off the durable snapshot, accumulated into a rolling window in-process; it stands down the same way while that window is still warming up or has a gap in it (see crassus/momentum.py). momentum_qqq also accepts two optional params, both off/no-op by default so no existing account's behavior changes unless explicitly set: 'vwap_confirmation_required' (bool) vetoes an otherwise-supported direction unless the underlying is on the agreeing side of its own session VWAP, and 'rvol_floor' (float) vetoes it unless relative volume clears that multiple -- both read from the collector-computed underlying_market block (see crassus/vwap_rvol.py and docs/plans/2026-07-vwap-rvol.md). Neither is set on any account below; RVOL in particular reports 'insufficient_history' until the collector's self-bootstrapping baseline has accumulated enough trading days, during which a held position is retained rather than closed, same as a stale snapshot. Below the original eight accounts, a second block of 'Phelps test bots' runs the same eight strategy/params pairings through crassus/phelps.py's phelps_wrap(), which defers a proposed close until Guideline Phelps' ~25-30 minute hold window has elapsed since entry (crassus/strategies/phelps_variants.py); a ninth account, Bowman, runs phelps_pure_qqq (crassus/strategies/phelps_pure.py), a strategy whose entry signal is itself derived from Phelps rather than borrowed from another strategy.

accounts._comment: Phelps test bots below: exact copies of the eight accounts above -- same alias root, same strategy, same params where the base account has any -- run through phelps_variants.py's phelps_wrap() instead of the bare strategy. The only behavioral difference is that a proposed close of a held position is deferred until phelps.PHELPS_MINUTES_DEFAULT (or an explicit phelps_minutes param) has elapsed since entry. Comparing e.g. Ankit vs. Ankit Phelps isolates exactly that one change.

Bowman: not a Phelps twin of an existing bot -- a new account whose only strategy is phelps_pure_qqq (crassus/strategies/phelps_pure.py), which builds both its entry (a short-window displacement trigger) and its exit (invalidation-or-Phelps-window) directly from Guideline Phelps rather than wrapping another strategy's signal. Named for Bob Bowman, Michael Phelps's coach, to keep 'Phelps' itself reserved for the guideline.
